03 / ABOUT US

Signature Nest
Gifts LLC

SIGNATURE NEST GIFTS LLC provides shop management and buyer customer care services for e-commerce businesses, with Etsy as our primary focus.

We bring listing management, advertising support, customer communications and reporting into a defined working arrangement. You remain the owner of your shop and make the decisions about your products and business.

A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Can I choose just one service?+

Yes. Tell us which areas you need help with. We’ll agree on an individual service or a wider support scope based on your needs.

How are services priced?+

We provide a tailored quote. Ongoing services may use a monthly fee, while listing work may be charged per completed listing. Etsy fees and advertising spend are separate.

Do I keep ownership of my shop?+

Yes. You remain the owner and account holder. Responsibilities and any access needed for our work are agreed during onboarding.

Do you guarantee sales or rankings?+

No. We provide the agreed operational services with care, but sales, search rankings, account status and platform decisions cannot be guaranteed.

Are you part of Etsy?+

No. Signature Nest Gifts LLC is an independent service provider and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Etsy, Amazon or Shopify.
